question: Explain why the electrostatic potential is constant throughout the volume of a conductor under electrostatic conditions. Give reason.

options.A: Potential is constant only at the centre of a conductor
options.B: Potential changes linearly throughout a conductor even though the electric field is zero
options.C: Potential is zero throughout any conductor, irrespective of its charge
options.D: Since $\vec E=0$ inside a conductor in electrostatic equilibrium, there is no potential difference between internal points; therefore potential is constant
